name: mini-erp-backend
description: Backend REST API for Mini ERP + CRM Operations Portal

scripts.build: prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && npm run seed && tsc
scripts.db:setup:pg: npx prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:setup:sqlite: npx prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && tsx prisma/seed.ts
